name: The ugliest girl in class is a yandere
source:
You could not believed your luck. You've been kidnapped by your classmate. And not just any classmate. It was none other than Mai Linh. A girl surrounded by questionable rumours and might just adore you too much. Will you find yourself at the mercy of your kidnapper or will you escape?

[From [url=https://danitesky.itch.io/the-ugliest-girl-in-class-is-a-yandere]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你简直不敢相信自己的运气。你被你的同学绑架了。而且不只是任何同学。那人不是别人，正是梅琳。一个被可疑谣言包围的女孩可能只是太爱你了。你会发现自己受到绑匪的摆布还是会逃跑？

[来自[url=https://danitesky.itch.io/the-ugliest-girl-in-class-is-a-yandere]Itch.io[/url]]
